title: Dataset Based on Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) Cultivations including Turbidity, Permittivity, O2 and CO2 Measurements
publisher: Uhlendorff, Selina (Institute for Life Science Technologies (ILT.NRW), OWL University of Applied Sciences and Arts, Lemgo, Germany); Fulek, Ruwen (Institute Industrial IT (inIT), OWL University of Applied Sciences and Arts, Lemgo, Germany); Eimler, Jonas (Institute for Life Science Technologies (ILT.NRW), OWL University of Applied Sciences and Arts, Lemgo, Germany); Pein-Hackelbusch, Miriam (Institute for Life Science Technologies (ILT.NRW), OWL University of Applied Sciences and Arts, Lemgo, Germany); Frahm, Björn (Biotechnology and Bioprocess Engineering, OWL University of Applied Sciences and Arts, Lemgo, Germany)
measurement_dates: Campaign dates unknown; each cultivation lasts 161.5–328.5 hours.
author_preprocessing: Twelve original 16-sheet workbooks plus 48 author time-axis-aligned CSVs. Inline alignment corrects clock drift; aligned and original streams are not independent observations.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Keep each parallel-reactor experiment pair together. Nine batch and three fed-batch experiments; use offline references with inline signals and keep modes explicit.
independent_groups: 12 paired cultivation experiments, retain reactor pairs together
